about: Fronts read by eye from the catalog's turntable renders (variation 0, four pictures a0-a3), for doodads the author hasn't measured. faces: the pictures that show the doodad's front (two side by side, or one for a diagonal front), or none when it has no front. sure: the front is plain and the pictures agree. The dressing turns a piece by a sure two-picture front and names every piece it turned so in one warning; placement and standOff are suggestions only. An author measurement in doodad-facings.json always wins. See docs/reference/doodad-facings.md.
pictures: Picture aN looks at the model from 315 - 90N degrees counterclockwise from east, pitched down 35: a0 from the south-east, a1 south-west, a2 north-west, a3 north-east. So a front pointing south (270) shows in a0 and a1, west (180) in a1 and a2, north (90) in a2 and a3, east (0) in a3 and a0. Calibrated on 2026-11-11 against the author's measured doodads.
